```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
report_start("eukaryote")

eu <- function(...) p("results", "eukaryote", ...)
assemblies <- ctx$assemblies

contig_lengths <- function(a) {
  file <- assembly_fasta(a)
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(tibble(contig = character(0), length = numeric(0)))
  as_tibble(fasta_table(file)) %>% select(contig, length)
}
lengths <- setNames(map(assemblies, contig_lengths), assemblies)

tiara <- map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
  file <- eu("tiara", paste0(a, ".tsv"))
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  read_table_quiet(file) %>%
    transmute(assembly_id = a, contig = sequence_id, class = class_fst_stage, second = class_snd_stage) %>%
    left_join(lengths[[a]], by = "contig")
})
fourcac <- map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
  file <- eu("4cac", paste0(a, ".tsv"))
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  read_table_quiet(file) %>%
    transmute(assembly_id = a, contig = contig_id, class = class) %>%
    left_join(lengths[[a]], by = "contig")
})
remag <- map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
  file <- eu("remag", paste0(a, ".tsv"))
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  read_table_quiet(file) %>%
    transmute(assembly_id = a, contig = contig_id, class = prediction, length, probability = eukaryote_prob)
})
remag_bins <- map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
  folder <- eu("remag", a, "bins")
  if (!dir.exists(folder)) return(NULL)
  files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.(fa|fasta)(\\.gz)?$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(tibble(assembly_id = a, bin = NA_character_, contigs = NA_real_, length = NA_real_))
  map_dfr(files, function(file) {
    table <- fasta_table(file)
    tibble(assembly_id = a, bin = basename(file), contigs = nrow(table), length = sum(as.numeric(table$length)))
  })
})

class_summary <- function(table, tool) {
  if (nrow(table) == 0) return(tibble())
  table %>%
    group_by(assembly_id, class) %>%
    summarise(contigs = n(), bases = sum(as.numeric(length), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(assembly_id) %>%
    mutate(contigs_pct = 100 * contigs / sum(contigs), bases_pct = 100 * bases / sum(bases)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(tool = tool)
}
is_eukaryotic <- function(class) grepl("euk", class, ignore.case = TRUE)
```

```{r brief}
section("Results in brief", {
  para("This module asks which contigs of an assembly come from eukaryotes such as fungi and protists. These are easily missed, because prokaryote tools don't recognize them. The ",
       "tools differ in their method, so where they agree a result is more reliable.")
  describe <- function(table, name) {
    if (nrow(table) == 0) return(NULL)
    euk <- filter(table, is_eukaryotic(class))
    paste0("**", name, "** classified ", fmt_int(nrow(table)), " contigs, ", fmt_int(nrow(euk)), " of them (", fmt_pct(100 * nrow(euk) / nrow(table)), ") as eukaryotic, with ",
           fmt_bp(sum(as.numeric(euk$length), na.rm = TRUE)), " of sequence.")
  }
  sentences <- c(describe(tiara, "Tiara"), describe(fourcac, "4CAC"), describe(remag, "REMAG"))
  if (length(sentences) == 0) {
    para("No output of this module was found. The module isn't part of the rule `all`, so run it with the target `eukaryote` or one of its tools.")
  } else {
    bullets(sentences)
  }
  if (nrow(remag_bins) > 0) {
    found <- filter(remag_bins, !is.na(bin))
    para("REMAG made **", nrow(found), " eukaryotic bins**", if (nrow(found) > 0) paste0(", with ", fmt_bp(sum(found$length)), " of sequence") else "", ".")
  }
})
```

```{r tiara}
tool_section <- function(table, tool, intro, file_part) {
  if (nrow(table) == 0) {
    no_output(tool, paste0("results/eukaryote/", file_part, "/"))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  para(intro)
  summary <- class_summary(table, tool)
  show_table(
    summary %>% transmute(Assembly = assembly_id, Class = class, Contigs = fmt_int(contigs), `Contigs %` = fmt_pct(contigs_pct), Length = fmt_bp(bases), `Length %` = fmt_pct(bases_pct)),
    paste0("Contigs and bases per class from ", tool),
    paste0(tolower(file_part), "_classes"),
    export = summary,
    max_rows = 40
  )
  levels_class <- names(sort(tapply(summary$bases, summary$class, sum), decreasing = TRUE))
  show_figure(
    summary %>%
      mutate(class = factor(class, levels = rev(levels_class))) %>%
      ggplot(aes(bases_pct, assembly_id, fill = class)) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(rep_len(PALETTE, length(levels_class)), levels_class), name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
      labs(x = "Share of the classified bases (%)", y = NULL) +
      theme_report(),
    paste0(tolower(file_part), "_classes"),
    paste0("Share of the classified bases per class from ", tool, ", per assembly."),
    height = rows_height(n_distinct(summary$assembly_id), 0.3, 1.3)
  )
  invisible(NULL)
}

section("Classification with Tiara", {
  tool_section(
    tiara, "Tiara",
    paste0(
      "Tiara classifies each contig by deep learning on its k-mers. Its first stage says archaea, bacteria, prokarya (a prokaryote of neither group), eukarya, organelle or unknown, and its second stage tells organelles apart. Contigs shorter than ",
      ctx$params$eukaryote$tiara$min_len %||% "?", " bp aren't classified, and so don't appear here. Short contigs carry little signal, so check the eukaryotic contigs before publishing them."
    ),
    "tiara"
  )
  if (nrow(tiara) > 0) {
    table <- filter(tiara, !is.na(second), second != "n/a") %>% count(assembly_id, class, second)
    if (nrow(table) > 0) {
      show_table(rename(table, Assembly = assembly_id, `First stage` = class, `Second stage` = second, Contigs = n), "Second stage of Tiara", "tiara_second_stage")
    }
  }
})
```

```{r fourcac}
section("Classification with 4CAC", {
  tool_section(
    fourcac, "4CAC",
    "4CAC combines machine learning on the sequence with the assembly graph: neighboring contigs in the graph often belong to the same element. It knows prokaryotes, eukaryotes, plasmids and viruses. It needs a graph, so it only runs on metaSPAdes assemblies.",
    "4cac"
  )
})
```

```{r remag}
section("Classification and binning with REMAG", {
  tool_section(
    remag, "REMAG",
    "REMAG first filters contigs with its classifier for eukaryotic sequences, and then bins the eukaryotic ones.",
    "remag"
  )
  if (nrow(remag_bins) > 0) {
    found <- filter(remag_bins, !is.na(bin))
    if (nrow(found) == 0) {
      para("REMAG found too little eukaryotic sequence for a bin in any assembly. It needs at least ", fmt_bp(as.numeric(ctx$params$eukaryote$remag$min_bin_size %||% NA)), ".")
    } else {
      show_table(
        found %>% arrange(desc(length)) %>% transmute(Assembly = assembly_id, Bin = bin, Contigs = fmt_int(contigs), Length = fmt_bp(length)),
        "Eukaryotic bins from REMAG. Check them with a tool for eukaryotes, such as EukCC or BUSCO, before calling them genomes",
        "remag_bins",
        export = found,
        max_rows = 40
      )
    }
  }
})
```

```{r agreement}
section("Where the tools agree", {
  pairs <- list(list("Tiara", tiara, "4CAC", fourcac), list("Tiara", tiara, "REMAG", remag), list("4CAC", fourcac, "REMAG", remag))
  shown <- FALSE
  for (pair in pairs) {
    a <- pair[[2]]
    b <- pair[[4]]
    if (nrow(a) == 0 || nrow(b) == 0) next
    joined <- inner_join(select(a, assembly_id, contig, first = class), select(b, assembly_id, contig, second = class), by = c("assembly_id", "contig"))
    if (nrow(joined) == 0) next
    table <- joined %>%
      mutate(first = ifelse(is_eukaryotic(first), "eukaryotic", "other"), second = ifelse(is_eukaryotic(second), "eukaryotic", "other")) %>%
      count(first, second)
    both <- sum(table$n[table$first == "eukaryotic" & table$second == "eukaryotic"])
    either <- sum(table$n[table$first == "eukaryotic" | table$second == "eukaryotic"])
    para("**", pair[[1]], " and ", pair[[3]], ":** ", fmt_int(both), " contigs are eukaryotic in both, of ", fmt_int(either), " that are eukaryotic in at least one, over ", fmt_int(nrow(joined)), " contigs that both tools classified.")
    write_tsv(table, file.path(ctx$tables, paste0("agreement_", tolower(pair[[1]]), "_", tolower(pair[[3]]), ".tsv")))
    shown <- TRUE
  }
  if (!shown) para("Only one of the tools has output, so there is nothing to compare.")
})
```

```{r methods}
section("Methods text", {
  para("You can use or adapt this text for a paper. It lists the tools with output in this project.")
  s <- ctx$params$eukaryote
  sentences <- c(
    if (nrow(tiara) > 0) paste0("Contigs of at least ", s$tiara$min_len %||% "?", " bp were classified with ", tv("Tiara"), " (probability cutoffs ", paste(unlist(s$tiara$prob_cutoff), collapse = " and "), ")."),
    if (nrow(fourcac) > 0) paste0("Contigs were also classified with 4CAC, using the metaSPAdes assembly graph (phage cutoff ", s$`4cac`$phage %||% "?", ", plasmid cutoff ", s$`4cac`$plasmid %||% "?", ")."),
    if (nrow(remag) > 0) paste0("Eukaryotic contigs were filtered and binned with ", tv("REMAG"), " (minimum contig length ", s$remag$min_contig_length %||% "?", " bp, minimum bin size ", s$remag$min_bin_size %||% "?", " bp).")
  )
  if (length(sentences) > 0) para("> ", paste(sentences, collapse = " ")) else para("There is no output to describe yet.")
})
```
